name: a-shell-redirect-into-keels-user-global-directory-is-refused
description: T231 through the other door: a guard that stops Write but not a redirect guards nothing, so the command half of the rule refuses a shell line that mutates the same file. The command names it with a tilde, which no gate-side resolution expands and only the running shell would - which is why the command half reads the text, exactly as the policy lock's own shell heuristic does.
